hero.title: Integrated Manufacturing Facility
hero.subtitle: Ghaziabad Industrial Area • 120,000 Sq. Ft
hero.alt: Paras Prints integrated corrugation and offset printing plant, Ghaziabad

intro: Unlike generalist packaging converters, Paras Prints Solutions operates fully integrated corrugated manufacturing lines and high-speed multi-colour Komori offset presses under one roof in Ghaziabad. From heavy-duty 3/5/7-ply master shippers to precision monocartons, our die-cut tooling delivers exact dimensional stability for high-speed automated packaging lines.
processHeading: From Raw Board to Finished Delivery:
processIntro: Strict quality gatechecks at every step ensure zero defective carton escapes and perfect compliance with client mechanical drawings.

process.title: Requirement & Engineering
process.body: Load analysis, internal dimensions, GSM requirement, and transport stress profiling.

process.title: CAD Dieline & Sample
process.body: Digital flatbed plotter cuts physical plain samples for physical product fitting checks.

process.title: Pre-Press & Litho Press
process.body: Komori 6-color litho printing with inline coating and Delta-E color proof matching.

process.title: Fluting & Lamination
process.body: Combining printed top-sheets to corrugated single facer fluting with bio-starch glue.

process.title: High-Tension Die Cutting
process.body: Precision steel-rule die punches with matrix crease lines preventing carton cracking.

process.title: Automated Gluing & Stitch
process.body: Vijaya lock-bottom gluing lines and industrial wire stitching for rigid corner seals.

process.title: Laboratory Metrology
process.body: Digital Bursting Strength (BS), GSM analytical balance, and moisture testing.

process.title: Dispatch & JIT Delivery
process.body: Strapped palletizing, shrink-wrapped moisture barrier, and scheduled fleet delivery.
